snippet.title: Feed It - Official Developer Overview Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Developer Overview Trailer for Feed It, a retro horror game developed by Games On A Chair. Players will live with a monster and do as they're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences. Feed It is coming soon to PC (Steam).
